A masked man stole the day's takings from {npc:Iriana}, in Yalahar, and fled over the rooftops. Chase him from bridge to bridge (always choosing the right side of each bridge) to {npc:Jimmy}'s hideout, steal a box of food for him from the cellar of {npc:Pugwah}'s tavern and return the chest to Iriana. The reward is 10 {item:Heaven Blossom|Heaven Blossoms}. It is part of the {wiki:Tibia Tales}.
A masked man has just stolen Iriana's earnings and she needs your help to get them back. But the chase may not be as easy as it seems.
Recommended: having started mission 4 of the {wiki:In Service of Yalahar Quest}, so you have easy access to the {wiki:Trade Quarter}.
to open the tunnel to the tavern cellar
Recommended: {spell:Invisibility} or {item:Stealth Ring} to avoid some creatures.
During the chase, fight the outlaws **without moving** (or avoid them) so you do not step on the wrong squares.

On several bridges you have to pass on a specific side (north/south/east/west). If you go the wrong side, the assassin leads you to a dead end and you can be attacked by a {creature:Thief (creature)|Thief}.
If you lose track of the assassin, go back to {npc:Iriana}, say {key:hi} and restart the chase from her roof.

If you are not in {wiki:Yalahar} yet, {npc:Captain Max} takes you there from **Liberty Bay** ({key:hi}, {key:yalahar}, {key:yes}; 400 gp, you need to have started the {wiki:In Service of Yalahar Quest}). If you already have the routes from that quest, there is a direct boat from Ab'Dendriel, Ankrahmun, Carlin, Darashia, Liberty Bay, Port Hope, Thais and Venore. The port is **south** of the Inner City and the {wiki:Trade Quarter} is right next to the port.
Karith, boat at the Yalahar harbour
Go to the **Trade Quarter** of Yalahar and look for {npc:Iriana}, next to the gate of the {wiki:Factory Quarter} guarded by {npc:Peter}. Say {key:hi}, {key:quest} and {key:yes}.
Enter Iriana's house and climb the ramp to the roof. To the **west** you see for a moment a white assassin who turns and disappears. You have to follow him.
The assassin only appears for a second before disappearing
2. Chase: first level of the rooftops
Follow the image: yellow = start, light green = destination (stairs to go up), dark green = right path, dark red = path to avoid.
From Iriana's roof, walk a few steps **west** and then **south** over the first bridge (the side does not matter).
Step one: right path (dark green) and wrong path (dark red)
Bridge to the west: SOUTH side
Walk south and you see the assassin again. Cross the bridge to the **west** along the **SOUTH** side of the bridge.
Walk **south**, where the assassin appears. On the next bridge pass on the **EAST** side (the one furthest from the building).
Keep going **south**, turn **west** into the building and go up one floor by the ladder.
3. Chase: second level of the rooftops
On this level there are {creature:Stalker|Stalkers} and {creature:Assassin|Assassins}. Follow the image: yellow = start, light green = destination (stairs to go down).
Walk to the right and **south** over the first bridge (the side does not matter).
Follow the bridges in this order, always passing on the indicated side:
In the next building, keep going south
Go to the edge of the building and turn north
Go down and go through the door

You see the assassin disappearing at the top of a staircase going down. Go down: there are two {creature:Bandit|Bandits}. Then head **south** and pass through the {item:Door (Sealed)|flashing door}. You find the NPC {npc:Jimmy}.
Say {key:hi} to {npc:Jimmy}: he shouts *"Get him!!"* and summons three {creature:Assassin|Assassins}. Kill them.
Say {key:hi} again, then {key:Iriana} and {key:yes}. To give you the money back, Jimmy wants you to steal a box of food from the tavern cellar next to the port, in the Inner City.
5. Steal the box from Pugwah's tavern
Go back to the **Inner City** of Yalahar and enter the sewers through the manhole **east** of the Depot or the one next to the ramp to the Trade Quarter.
Manhole next to the Trade Quarter ramp
Walk to the marked patch of earth and use the {item:Pick} on it. You are transported to a tunnel.
Use the Pick on the red square
Walk **north-east**, climb up with the {item:Rope} and use the box (100 oz.) to the **west**. You get one in your inventory.
The box weighs 100 oz.: make sure you have free capacity.

Go back the same way: go down again at the spot where you used the {item:Rope}, return through the tunnel to the sewers and climb up through one of the manholes you came in by ({coord:32802,31239,7} or {coord:32836,31255,7}).
Manhole next to the Trade Quarter ramp

Go back to {npc:Jimmy} (you do not need to repeat the route over the rooftops) and say {key:quest}. He swaps the box for the {item:Iriana's Chest} (120 oz.). Jimmy is beyond the sealed door at the docks in the **south-east** of the Trade Quarter, the same flashing door you came through.
Take the chest to {npc:Iriana} and say {key:quest}. You receive 10 {item:Heaven Blossom|Heaven Blossoms}.

To leave the city, go up to the boat of {npc:Karith} at the port (1 floor up): if you have already completed the mission *Searoutes around Yalahar* of the In Service of Yalahar Quest, he takes you to Ab'Dendriel, Ankrahmun, Carlin, Darashia, Liberty Bay, Port Hope, Thais or Venore ({key:hi}, name of the city, {key:yes}). Otherwise, {npc:Captain Cookie}, on the boat to the left of Karith's, takes you to Liberty Bay (400 gp) or Thais (800 gp).
Karith, boat at the Yalahar harbour
If you lose the assassin and go back to Iriana, she tells you to restart from her house; you do not need to accept the mission again.
